title: OpenFactCheck: A Unified Framework for Factuality Evaluation of LLMs
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures the factual accuracy of Large Language Models' knowledge about religion as part of a broader evaluation of factuality against world knowledge.
findings: The paper includes 'Religion' as one of the top-20 domains in its FactQA dataset, with 63 examples designated for testing factual knowledge. However, the paper does not report specific performance findings for any LLM on this religious domain.
